archetypes.name: transport-kv
archetypes.rationale: Slack announcer transport and KV envelope behavior are the main runtime contract.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Slack issue announce code path for parity with the deleted shell wrapper. Focus on missing tmpdir handling, nonexistent tmpdir handling, best-effort exit codes, URL scheme rejection, and newline-free ERROR values. Confirm urllib Request construction preserves the posted JSON body and headers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retirement-map
archetypes.rationale: Deleted script paths must remain reachable only through the retirement manifest.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the script retirement integration. Check Makefile wiring, agent-lint reachability pins, residual Bash tracking, migrated-scripts.tsv entries, and the implement skill registry. Look for stale references to deleted Slack shell files outside the retirement manifest. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: pytest-contracts
archetypes.rationale: The shell harness was replaced by colocated pytest coverage.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new pytest coverage for the Slack issue announcer. Verify it covers posted, skipped, failed, best-effort, invalid scheme, missing argument, nonexistent tmpdir, and multiline transport error paths without relying on real network access. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
